purpose: Binds every load-bearing claim to its evidence file, field and sha256, plus the scope it is allowed to support and the extrapolation it forbids.

patchtst.must_be_stated: PatchTST was NOT run. This may not be written as 'the PatchTST experiment failed' — no PatchTST experiment exists. It is a pre-defined gate decision plus model-complexity control. When real data arrives, deep models may be re-evaluated from scratch.

transfer_mechanism_meaning: The frozen source ARC clip/scaler defines the FEATURE SPACE and is reused unchanged; the regression head (coef + intercept) is refitted on target-domain rows only. The frozen source coefficients are NOT used as a prior — Phase 3 ruled SOURCE_PRIOR_NOT_VALIDATED and that ruling stands.

claims.claim: The final point model is target_only_arc_space: the frozen source ARC clip/scaler defines the feature space and is reused unchanged, while the regression head is refitted on target-domain rows only.
claims.allowed_scope: the frozen configuration replayed by this package
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be described as a source model generalising into the space domain; the frozen source COEFFICIENTS are not used

claims.claim: The transfer mechanism is FEATURE_SPACE_TRANSFER_WITH_TARGET_DOMAIN_HEAD_REFIT.
claims.allowed_scope: a coordinate system crossed the domain gap; a predictive function did not
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be restated as 'frozen source coefficients provided additional gain'

claims.claim: Source PRE-PROCESSING transfer has measured value: the ARC source space beat a target-native Ridge on 6/6 environment families.
claims.allowed_scope: simulated environment families in this study
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be restated as the source PARAMETER prior being validated

claims.claim: The source PARAMETER prior was not validated: inner folds chose lambda_source=0 in 44 of 72 cells (61.1%), and every non-zero choice was the grid minimum 0.01.
claims.value: SOURCE_PRIOR_NOT_VALIDATED on all three formal priors
claims.allowed_scope: the pre-locked six-value lambda grid
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be reopened by widening the grid upward — the selected values sit at the BOTTOM of it

claims.claim: Point accuracy: family-macro MAE 0.003328 absolute SOH for the final model, under leave-one-family-out over 6 held-out environment families, H in {2,4,8}.
claims.allowed_scope: STK-derived simulated twin only, 120 simulated trajectories
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be described as real-satellite accuracy or an on-orbit guarantee

claims.claim: The non-learning baseline observable_local_trend_extrapolation reaches 0.003588 on the same sample set, so the fitted model's margin over a closed-form slope extrapolation is about 7.2%.
claims.allowed_scope: the identical sample set as the final model
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: the small margin may not be inflated into a large one; the baseline requires no fitting at all

claims.claim: TIME_NORMALIZATION_GATE: T1 rate-per-day is ALGEBRAICALLY IDENTICAL to T0 under per-horizon separate fitting, verified to 2.8e-13 over 72 cells at the same alpha against a 1e-10 tolerance.
claims.allowed_scope: a reparameterisation identity, with a deliberately-mismatched control arm that does not close
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: no MAE difference between T0 and T1 may be described as a time-normalisation gain

claims.claim: EXPOSURE_GATE: planned future exposure does not exist in this dataset — future_planned_delta_efc is NULL on 100% of rows, so T2 was never run.
claims.allowed_scope: the evidence status INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_AT_PREDICTION_TIME
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: realized exposure may NEVER be substituted — it reads the trajectory after the cutoff and is ORACLE_AUDIT_ONLY

claims.claim: STRESS_GATE_LOW_DATA and STRESS_GATE_FULL_DATA: stress was built, audited and run — 25 of 29 derived obs_hist_* fields cleared the identifiability audit — and neither F2 nor F3 passed a gate.
claims.allowed_scope: observable history derived under a <= context_end prefix bound
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be restated as 'stress features help'; adding more stress columns is not the indicated next step

claims.claim: No strict counterfactual is producible: the digital-twin generator is absent from this project, so every factor-direction claim is capped at OBSERVATIONAL_EVIDENCE and labelled NON_CAUSAL.
claims.allowed_scope: association within the simulated data
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: no causal claim about any stress factor may be made

claims.claim: The orbit triplet (altitude, inclination, RAAN) maps ONE-TO-ONE onto the 6 environment families, so each is a family-identity proxy and is permanently excluded from every model input.
claims.value: excluded by measurement, not by taste
claims.allowed_scope: the exclusion rule
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be reintroduced under a re-encoding

claims.claim: Uncertainty at 90% nominal: family-macro coverage 0.9045, worst family 0.7641 (h550_i053_raan180), mean interval width 0.016053 SOH.
claims.allowed_scope: PER-HORIZON MARGINAL coverage, STK-derived simulated twin only
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: NOT simultaneous across the three horizons; NOT family-conditional; NOT an on-orbit coverage guarantee; may not be repaired by widening post hoc

claims.claim: Uncertainty at 95% nominal: family-macro coverage 0.9530, worst family 0.8628, mean width 0.023213 SOH.
claims.allowed_scope: PER-HORIZON MARGINAL coverage, STK-derived simulated twin only
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: same prohibitions as the 90% row

claims.claim: CONFORMAL_GATE is CONFORMAL_NOT_VALIDATED. Two shortfall flags fired: CONFORMAL_WORST_FAMILY_SHORTFALL and FIXED_HOLDOUT_COVERAGE_SHORTFALL (fixed-holdout window-micro coverage 0.8683 at 90% nominal). CONFORMAL_FAMILY_MACRO_SHORTFALL did NOT fire.
claims.allowed_scope: the measured shortfall, reported as measured
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: the shortfall may not be 'fixed' by re-calibration; the gate may not be reported as passed

claims.claim: The two group-aware calibration methods coincide by ARITHMETIC on this dataset (every family holds exactly 20 trajectories), measured max |delta coverage| = 0.0.
claims.allowed_scope: an algebraic identity of this family design
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: the robustness control's agreement is NOT independent corroboration of the family-balanced result

claims.claim: POOLED_SPLIT_CONFORMAL is NOT group-aware: its finite-sample correction counts ~10,000 overlapping windows rather than 100 independent trajectories, which is why its interval is narrower and its coverage lower.
claims.allowed_scope: a control quantifying the cost of ignoring group structure
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may never be described as group-aware, and is not a candidate

claims.claim: RUL, arm FINAL_MODEL: 92 eligible anchors, crossing detection 0.3478, false alarm 0.0088 over 10953 negatives.
claims.allowed_scope: a secondary display derived from the SOH point predictions, STK-derived simulated twin only
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: RUL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT — no ranking may rest on it

claims.claim: RUL, arm STABILITY_BASELINE: 92 eligible anchors, crossing detection 0.1413, false alarm 0.0023 over 10953 negatives.
claims.allowed_scope: a secondary display derived from the SOH point predictions, STK-derived simulated twin only
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: RUL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT — no ranking may rest on it

claims.claim: The RUL eligible label is structurally degenerate: all 92 eligible anchors carry target_rul_days == 112.0 with std 0.0, because the simulation terminates at EOL. A constant 112-day predictor would score MAE = 0.
claims.allowed_scope: a data-shape limitation of this dataset
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: RUL MAE may not be used to rank arms or to claim remaining-life prediction accuracy; the eligible set may not be widened to escape the degeneracy

claims.claim: The warning lead time is nearly vacuous: 90 of the 92 eligible anchors are already at or below the 0.80 threshold when observed (mean anchor SOH ~ 0.755), leaving 2 anchors behind each reported mean.
claims.allowed_scope: an honest description of the eligible set's construction
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be quoted as a warning-capability metric

claims.claim: PatchTST was NOT run and NOT implemented. Phase 6 was closed by a pre-declared gate; no PatchTST result exists, favourable or unfavourable.
claims.allowed_scope: a decision not to run, taken on pre-declared grounds
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may NOT be written as 'the PatchTST experiment failed', 'PatchTST underperformed', 'deep models were empirically ruled out' or 'a neural baseline was measured' — all four would be fabrications

claims.claim: The evaluation is leakage-free by construction: the held-out family enters no fit, no selection, no calibration set and no quantile, and calibration residuals come from a leave-one-FAMILY-out cross-fit, which is strictly stronger than leave-one-trajectory-out.
claims.allowed_scope: the nested LOFO protocol as executed
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: the fixed holdout may NOT be called a virgin or never-seen test set — the frozen Task C never read the split column and family-LOFO trains on those families in 6/6 folds

claims.claim: Every result in this package was measured on an STK-derived simulated twin. No real on-orbit telemetry entered any stage of the work.
claims.allowed_scope: a method and protocol validated in simulation
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: this is NOT a flight-qualified predictor; real-satellite performance was NEVER TESTED

claims.claim: This package is a CANDIDATE. It promotes nothing, creates no production v2, and modifies no formal recommended configuration.
claims.allowed_scope: CANDIDATE_NOT_PROMOTED
claims.forbidden_extrapolation: may not be described as a promoted or production model

statements_that_may_not_be_made: the Phase 3 SOURCE_PRIOR_NOT_VALIDATED verdict is overturned
family-conditional or on-orbit coverage is guaranteed
coverage holds simultaneously across the three horizons
STK simulation metrics are real-satellite accuracy
the 90% band covers the 112-day trajectory with 90% probability
the robustness control confirms the family-balanced result
the fixed holdout is a virgin / never-seen test set
deep models were empirically ruled out on this dataset
an RUL beyond 112 days was predicted
the RUL MAE of two arms computed on different eligible sets may be compared
